strategy.name: EMA Cross Momentum
strategy.description: 9/21 EMA crossover with RSI(14) filter, volume confirmation, and VWAP session bias. One of the most backtested crypto strategies. Designed for 15m timeframe on BTC.

indicators.ema_9: Fast EMA. Crosses above EMA(21) = bullish momentum starting.
indicators.ema_21: Slow EMA. Price relationship to this determines trend strength.
indicators.rsi_14: Standard RSI. Filter zone 35-65 — avoids entering overbought or oversold extremes.
indicators.vwap: Session bias. Price above = buyers in control.
indicators.volume: Must be above 20-period average to confirm the move is real.

long: EMA(9) crosses above EMA(21) — momentum turning bullish
Price above VWAP — session bias bullish
RSI(14) between 35 and 65 — not overbought, trend has room to run
Volume above 20-period average — move is confirmed by participation
short: EMA(9) crosses below EMA(21) — momentum turning bearish
Price below VWAP — session bias bearish
RSI(14) between 35 and 65 — not oversold, trend has room to run
Volume above 20-period average — move is confirmed by participation

exit_rules: EMA(9) crosses back in opposite direction
RSI(14) reaches extreme (above 70 for longs, below 30 for shorts)
risk_rules: Max trade size capped by MAX_TRADE_SIZE_USD
notes: Best on 15m BTCUSDT. Volume filter is key — without it false crossovers are common in low-volume periods.
